verdict.rationale: Honeybadger's MCP integration lets a connected AI assistant perform 'Error investigation' and run BadgerQL queries against error data, and its search UI offers an AI-assisted natural-language query builder, but there is no documented feature where Honeybadger itself analyzes stack traces, breadcrumbs, and commits to propose a root cause. Missing for 10: a first-party root-cause-analysis engine, explicit commit/breadcrumb correlation, and any actionable fix suggestion output.
